title: Show HN: DemandMap – Memory Mapping S3 into Polars on macOS Without FUSE
snippet: Basically this exists to solve one of my biggest pain-points with dataframe libraries and big data. It's basically impossible to lazily download data on S3 with polars unless you're processing it strictly sequentially, and even then, it won't work with arrow and numpy data. This allows you to "download" a multi-gigabyte file on S3 into a Polars DataFrame in <100ms. # Demo       alloc = demandmap.S
